Criterion 1 rests on regression 311 (pnpm db:reset from an empty local database, then the core, workspace and harness suites); the qa check at 316 ran the core suite only, on the same tree.
The suite measures that the schema refuses an update of a derived member, not that part 9's trigger is what refuses it, because 17 of 29 tenancy members are refused 23503 by a parent key either way.
seen.guard_authored_identifiers() runs at apply time only, so a later migration adding a table with a tenant_id gets no immutability trigger, and nothing hands that obligation forward yet.
